We’re so proud of the progress they’re making- week 4 down, and so much more to learn! 🎓✨

posts.title: Celebrating a dental assisting class

posts.alt: An academy team member marking ten years with Roseville Dental Academy and Waikiki Dental.
posts.caption:
✨10 YEARS✨

On September 6th marked a pretty incredible milestone, 10 years in my career with Roseville Dental Academy and Waikiki Dental! 🦷🤍

Ten years of learning, growing, teaching, challenging myself, building relationships, and becoming the professional I am today. There have been amazing days, hard days, lessons I never expected, and so many moments that reminded me why I love what I do.

I’m incredibly grateful for everyone who has been part of this journey coworkers, students, mentors, and all the people who have trusted me along the way.

What started as a job turned into a career that has given me so many opportunities to grow and make a difference. I’m proud of how far I’ve come and excited for whatever the next chapter brings.

10 years down… and I’m just getting started!🦷🥂✨
